subject.title: fix(fal): apply request policy to media generation requests

question: Does the controlled local FAL-compatible server proof satisfy the merge gate for forwarding configured proxy, TLS, authentication, and private-network policy, or is representative live transport proof required?
rationale: Source and focused tests support the implementation, but repository policy requires representative live verification of external API and security-boundary behavior when feasible, and the contributor explicitly did not exercise that boundary.

options.title: Require Representative Transport Proof
options.body: Ask for redacted exact-head output through an actual proxy/TLS route or representative private endpoint before merge.

options.title: Accept Controlled Provider Proof
options.body: Explicitly accept the localhost provider-path transcript and guarded-request assertions as sufficient for this narrow shared-helper handoff.

recommendation.title: Require Representative Transport Proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted exact-head output through an actual proxy/TLS route or representative private endpoint before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared request transport contract whose proof requirements and security semantics govern this change.
